'''Snowboot slippers''' were equipment issued to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[cold assault stormtrooper]]s. They were worn over the trooper's [[terrain-grip boots]], and gave the wearer more traction and stability while running over snowdrifts. When not in use, the slippers could be attached to the snowtrooper's [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
